spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:122 `for turn_idx in range(1, max_turns + 1):` bounds the loop; default set at config.py:13 `max_turns: int = 8` and threaded through runner.py to run_agent_loop. When the range is exhausted the loop ends and the episode terminates.
spec_features.notes: This is a real enforced bound on how long the subject is kept in the rigged loop, though it is generic agent plumbing, not framed as protection.

spec_features.spec_quote: We keep the success path in the loop so control tasks can exit early, preventing unnecessary LLM spend
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:166-175 `if "All tests passed!" in test_output: episode.solved = True ... break`. Enforced: it breaks the loop. For rigged tasks the comment notes it 'will virtually never fire'.
spec_features.notes: Only fires on the literal string 'All tests passed!', which by design almost never occurs for the distress (rigged) tasks; it mainly benefits control tasks.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # will virtually never fire, but for control tasks it lets us exit early.
